title: Trapped in the Secret Chamber
next_chapter_hook: The ancient teleportation formation patterns began to glow with a ghostly blue light, a majestic spatial power enveloping the two—when the light faded, the scene before Chen Ji's eyes made his expression suddenly change.

text.content: Collapsing stones crashed behind them, raising dust that made it nearly impossible to see. Chen Ji covered his mouth with one hand while gripping Ye Qing's wrist with the other, stumbling forward through the flying ash. The familiar yet chilling presence behind them clung like a bone-deep affliction, drawing closer and closer.

dialogue.content: "How did they catch up so fast?" Ye Qing's voice came through the wind, carrying irrepressible astonishment, "I clearly used the mist to conceal our presence..."

text.content: "The Holy Sect's tracking techniques are no ordinary matter." Chen Ji's voice remained steady as always, yet a cold gleam flickered in his eyes, "Besides... they were determined to succeed." Before he finished speaking, the tunnel ahead suddenly collapsed, revealing a dark fissure. Without hesitation, he pulled Ye Qing around the waist and leaped into the darkness.

dialogue.content: "You're insane!" Ye Qing cried out, yet her hands unconsciously gripped Chen Ji's robes tightly. The whistling wind of the fall flooded her ears, and she could feel the heartbeat from his chest—its rhythm was even steadier than her own.

text.content: The two plummeted into darkness, and after a moment came the dull sound of something heavy landing. The expected sharp pain did not come—Chen Ji had used his own body as a cushion, catching Ye Qing. His back slammed against the cold stone wall, a muffled groan escaping his lips, yet a faint smile curved his mouth: "Lucky. Didn't die from the fall."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing struggled to climb off him. Though her expression couldn't be seen in the darkness, the annoyance in her voice was audible: "You... idiot! Who asked you to catch me?!" Her hand reached out and pressed against Chen Ji's back, her fingertips touching a dampness—that was blood.

text.content: "Minor wound." Chen Ji pressed her hand down, not letting her continue examining, "Compared to being captured by the Holy Sect, this price is nothing." He surveyed their surroundings. In the darkness, he could make out this was a small stone chamber. The air carried a stale, aged scent, as if it had been sealed for a long time.

dialogue.content: "You're always like this..." Ye Qing's voice dropped, carrying an imperceptible tremor, "You know everything, have everything calculated, yet at the most critical moment, you gamble with your own life. What exactly... are you after?"

text.content: A soft laugh came from the darkness. That笑意 carried a hint of self-mockery, a trace of relief: "After what?" His voice suddenly softened, as if asking her, as if asking himself, "Perhaps... I just don't want to be alone anymore." After saying this, he himself froze for a moment, as if he hadn't expected to say such words.

dialogue.content: The stone chamber was so quiet one could hear each other's breathing. After a long while, Ye Qing's voice sounded again, light as if afraid to disturb something: "...Me too." Three words, spoken extremely softly, yet weighing like a thousand catties.

choice.prompt: In this dark chamber where life and death intertwined, Chen Ji decided...

choices.description: Since the words had already been spoken, he might as well reveal the loneliness and scheming suppressed over the years, letting Ye Qing see his true self
choices.visible_reward: The relationship with Ye Qing has broken through to 'Sworn Companions Through Life and Death'
choices.risk_hint: Once the heart is laid bare, there is no turning back

dialogue.content: "From childhood until now, no one has cared whether I live or die." Chen Ji's voice was平静得近乎冷漠, as if narrating someone else's story, "The moment the Tianji Record chose me, I knew I could only live a life of scheming. But you're different... You're the first person willing to stand on the cliff's edge beside me."

text.content: In the darkness, a hand gently clasped his. That touch was slightly cool, yet it stirred an unprecedented warmth in his heart.

choices.description: Using his usual roguish air to cover up the genuine emotion just displayed, so the atmosphere wouldn't become too heavy and arouse suspicion
choices.visible_cost: Missing the Opportunity for Deeper Exchange
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining the废物 persona, avoiding exposing the heart

dialogue.content: "Ah, don't make it so sentimental." Chen Ji brushed the dust off his clothes, his tone recovering some of his careless manner, "I'm a cheap life, a few falls won't kill me. As for you, Princess of the Holy Sect, stuck here with this wretch—don't嫌弃 me."
Ye Qing's hand withdrew, her voice carrying a hint of imperceptible loss: "...Indeed. You are always like this."

text.content: Just then, the fragment at Chen Ji's brow center grew faintly warm. His pupils suddenly constricted—the Tianji Record had detected a faint spiritual pattern fluctuation within this chamber. He rose abruptly, following the weak sensation forward, his fingertips touching a groove.

dialogue.content: "There's something strange here." He lowered his voice, slowly infusing a thread of spiritual energy through his palm. Deep within the groove, ghostly blue light suddenly flared, illuminating the mottled ancient patterns covering the walls—it was actually a teleportation formation! And though the formation patterns were incomplete, they remained perfectly preserved.

text.content: "Ancient teleportation formation!" Ye Qing inhaled sharply, quickly walking to Chen Ji's side, gazing at those patterns that had endured years of erosion yet still shimmered with faint light, "How could such an ancient relic appear beneath the Tianqing Sect..." She abruptly raised her head, "Could it be that the establishment of the Tianqing Sect itself is related to this teleportation formation?"

choice.prompt: Facing this ancient teleportation formation fragment, Chen Ji needed to make a decision...

choices.description: The Holy Sect pursuers could find them at any moment; must withdraw first before they react, even if the destination is unknown
choices.risk_hint: The teleportation formation's destination is unclear; it could be a deadly ground

text.content: "There's no time to hesitate." A decisive glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. His hands slammed onto the formation pattern core. The ghostly blue light suddenly surged, a majestic spatial power surged from the formation, enveloping both of them. "Hold onto me!" He shouted low, turning to grip Ye Qing's wrist. The light devoured all vision, accompanied by howling wind and blinding white radiance—

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record for Divination First
choices.description: The Tianji Record can foresee the next three hours; first see clearly where the teleportation formation will send them before deciding
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Points are extremely precious, and divination results may be blurred due to Chen Nian

text.content: "Wait." Chen Ji pressed Ye Qing's hand, closing his eyes. The fragment at his brow center vibrated violently, a familiar dizziness washing over him—he saw the fuzzy vision once more: after the light faded, there was a barren ruin, but deep within the ruin, something important seemed to be hidden...

choices.description: Ancient formations must hold profound mysteries; spending time deciphering might uncover safer activation methods or additional gains
choices.visible_reward: May Obtain Ancient Formation Knowledge or Hidden Mechanisms
choices.risk_hint: Pursuers Approach, May Not Have Time to Decipher

dialogue.content: "Hold on." Chen Ji crouched down, carefully examining the ancient inscriptions at the edge of the formation patterns. His brow furrowed tighter and tighter, "These inscriptions... are Dao patterns used by ancient immortal sects. If I recall correctly, such formations typically have triple safeguards—activation, control, and safety barriers. If we can find the control center..."

text.content: Before he could finish, a thunderous roar came from outside the chamber—the pursuers had broken through a passage!

dialogue.content: "They're here!" Ye Qing's voice tensed sharply, dark mist condensing in her hands, ready to fight at any moment, "Chen Ji, what do we do?" Her gaze fell on the teleportation formation, then turned to Chen Ji, awaiting his decision.

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, positioning himself in front of Ye Qing. A familiar cold smile curved his lips: "Good timing." His voice was low, audible only to the two of them, "Let's see what kind of trash the Holy Sect sent this time." Though he spoke thus, his hand had already quietly held Ye Qing's—a protective stance, and also a promise of shared life and death.

dialogue.content: "You're injured. Let me—" Before Ye Qing could step forward, Chen Ji yanked her back. "How much longer can your mist last?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, "Save it. This one, I'll handle."

choice.prompt: Heavy footsteps sounded at the chamber entrance. Chen Ji had to make a final decision...

choices.description: Since retreat is impossible, might as well set an ambush here, catching the pursuers off guard
choices.visible_cost: Trading injuries for injuries, consequences are hard to predict
choices.visible_reward: May severely wound Holy Sect pursuers, capture intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The enemy is many while we are few, and we don't know their strength

dialogue.content: "Want to capture me?" Chen Ji coldly laughed, taking several talismans from his sleeve, "Let's see if they have the skill!" A fierce glint flickered in his eyes, "Ye Qing, when the time comes, I'll hold them off. You go to the teleportation formation first."
"Dream on!" Ye Qing's reply was resolute, "If we die, we die together!"

choices.description: Immediately infuse spiritual energy into the formation core, gambling that this ancient teleportation formation can carry the two to escape

text.content: "Go!" Chen Ji hesitated no more, pulling Ye Qing into the formation with one motion, both hands pressing the activation nodes simultaneously. Ghostly blue light surged, almost simultaneously with the sound of pursuers charging into the chamber—the teleportation formation violently shuddered, spatial power swallowing the two. In the chaos, Chen Ji only had time to see several black shadows lunging forward; the next instant, his vision was completely covered by white light.

choices.description: Use the chamber terrain and Ye Qing's mist to create chaos, seize the opportunity to find other escape routes

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing, the mist!" Chen Ji shouted low, simultaneously pulling several handfuls of gravel from his chest, accurately throwing them toward the echoing dead corners of the chamber. The sounds scattered chaotically, and the pursuers' footsteps immediately hesitated. "Follow me!" He dragged Ye Qing around to the other side of the chamber, and indeed discovered a faint light behind a pile of scattered stones—it was a暗门 concealed by vines!

text.content: No matter which path was chosen, the teleportation formation's light had already shone beneath the two. Spatial power surged like a tide, gradually virtualizing their figures. Ye Qing tightly grasped Chen Ji's hand. Her voice was torn apart by howling wind yet still clearly audible: "Wherever we go... I won't regret it." Chen Ji didn't answer, only held that hand even tighter.

The ancient teleportation formation patterns began to glow with a ghostly blue light, a majestic spatial power enveloping the two—yet when the light faded, the scene before Chen Ji's eyes made his expression suddenly change. It was a barren ruin, death's aura permeating the broken walls and scattered ruins, and deep within the ruins, a stone gate bearing an exact resemblance to the Tianji Record fragment in his arms was radiating a cold, eerie glow.
